nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Failures' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.result.status = 'FAILURE' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

SELECT count(*) AS 'Denials' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.authorizationInfo.result = 'DENY' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND (data.result.status = {{result_status}} OR {{result_status}} = 'all') AND (data.authorizationInfo.result = {{authz_result}} OR {{authz_result}} = 'all') AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET type LIMIT 20

SELECT timestamp, type, `data.methodName`, `data.result.status`, `data.result.data.errorType`, `data.result.data.message`, `data.authenticationInfo.principal`, `data.authorizationInfo.result`, `data.authorizationInfo.operation`, `data.authorizationInfo.resourceType`, source FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND (data.result.status = {{result_status}} OR {{result_status}} = 'all') AND (data.authorizationInfo.result = {{authz_result}} OR {{authz_result}} = 'all') AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all') LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.connector = {{crn_connector}} OR {{crn_connector}} = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET `data.context.connectorId` LIMIT 10

SELECT timestamp, `data.context.connectorId`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.message`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.rootCause`, source FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.connector = {{crn_connector}} OR {{crn_connector}} = 'all') LIMIT 100

nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(data.result.status) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(data.authorizationInfo.result) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.environment) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source IN ('confluent-audit', 'confluent-connector') SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.cloud_cluster) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.schema_registry) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.connector) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' SINCE 1 week ago
